notes:
Lead profile: small-headless storefront + marketplace partnerships. Inbound came from blog post on product Q&A. Wants self-serve hosted API; prefers quick onboarding and low ops.

Use patterns / constraints:
- Primary workloads: product Q&A (chat widget on product pages), nightly catalog enrichment (attribute extraction + canonicalization), search rerank for relevance tuning.
- Catalog: ~40k SKUs, mix of short titles and long vendor descriptions (~1k chars).
- Traffic: mostly bursty (sale windows, promo emails). Baseline 20-30 req/min; peaks up to 400-600 req/min during campaigns (short-lived).
- Latency target: ~200-300ms median for single-turn product Q&A; 95th < 800ms acceptable during peaks.
- Throughput: embeddings batch jobs overnight for 40k items; want fast warm-up for daytime queries.
- Cost sensitivity: "must keep monthly spend < $2k during pilot" per CFO. Looking for unit-cost guidance (batching + cache).
- Model preferences: open to Redwood-curated small footprint models for cost; wants option to fall back to higher-quality model for complex queries.
- Routing/fallback: prefer rules to route simple Qs to smaller, cheaper model and escalate long/higher-confidence failures to larger model.
- Security/compliance: public cloud acceptable; will need SSO (SAML) for team; audit logs for API usage; retention policy: 90 days for POC, can extend for production.

Conversation snippets (paraphrased):
- "We need answers on product pages that don't hallucinate — attribute grounding critical."
- "During peak launches we can get hammered for 10-15 minutes — need graceful degradation, not a 500 every time."

POC milestones agreed:
- 1) Provide trial API key + quickstart snippet (done).
- 2) SE to run throughput test against sample dataset and send delta-cost estimate (next).
- 3) Run enrichment job for 5k SKUs, evaluate attribute extraction F1 and token cost.
